question_text: Jacob's rainwater tank started leaking. The amount of water in the tank after $t$ hours is given by $W(t) = 1000 - 0.5t\text{ litres}$.

subparts.solution:
$W(0) = 1000$
The initial amount of water in the tank was $1000\text{ L}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The initial amount corresponds to time $t = 0$.

subparts.stem: Find $t$ when $W(t) = 700$, and explain what this represents.
subparts.solution:
$W(t) = 700$, so $700 = 1000 - 0.5t$
$\therefore 0.5t = 300$
$\therefore t = 600$
After $600\text{ hours}$, or $25\text{ days}$, the amount of water in the tank is $700\text{ L}$.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Substitute the given function value into the linear equation and solve for the unknown variable $t$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Arithmetic errors when dividing by $0.5$ (multiplying by $2$ instead of dividing).

subparts.stem: How long will it take for the tank to empty?
subparts.solution:
The tank is empty when $W(t) = 0$.
This occurs when $0.5t = 1000$
$\therefore t = 2000$
It will take $2000\text{ hours}$, or $83\text{ days}, 8\text{ hours}$, for the tank to empty.

ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Converting hours to days incorrectly (dividing by 24 gives $83.333...$ days, which is 83 days and 8 hours).
